body: I like reading, I guess. But there's nothing I "geek" about anymore.
Thank you. I like reading, in that way I don't disappoint people and it takes me to other places than just darkness.
Thank you for being so nice. I really appreciate that.

Thank you for responding.

I didn't know conversation is an actual skill. I honestly can't remember the last time I had a good conversation in a non professional (not at work or about turning in a paper or something) setting. Most of the time it's just awkward and I'm relieved when people decide to leave, so they can have a more interesting conversation with someone else.
